skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply advanced macroeconomic theories to analyze and explain the impact of events and policies on economies, and government and central bank policy reactions.
Use quantitative techniques to analyze economic relationships and evaluate the impact of macroeconomic events and policy changes on the economy.
Develop skills in data searching, secondary literature synthesis, and applying economic tools to real-world economic situations.
Enhance independent research skills, teamwork, and presentation skills to communicate knowledge through writing and discussing real-world macroeconomic situations.
Improve self-study and research skills to enhance knowledge on real-world macroeconomic issues.
Enhance the ability to critically analyze macroeconomic issues in Vietnam and around the world.
